item.title: Afroman found not liable in defamation case brought by Ohio cops who raided home
item.description:
📝 Afroman did not defame Ohio cops in a satirical music video that featured footage of them fruitlessly raiding the rapper’s house, a jury found on Wednesday. item.title: 2% of ICML papers desk rejected because the authors used LLM in their reviews
item.description:
📝 After a selection process, in which reviewers got to choose which policy they would like to operate under, they were assigned to either Policy A or Policy B. 795 reviews (~1% of all reviews) written by 506 unique reviewers who were assigned Policy A (no LLMs) were detected to have used LLMs in their review. All Policy A (no LLMs) reviews that were detected to be LLM generated were removed from the system.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.icml.cc/2026/03/18/on-violations-of-llm-review-policies/
